name: Maine

windshield.strip: above the AS-1 line or, if there is no AS-1 line, a 5-inch strip at the top of the windshield; below that no material reducing transmittance below the original window
windshield.reflective: no reflective material on any window

backSide.note: 35% limit does not apply to side windows behind the operator if the vehicle has 2 outside mirrors (one each side)

rear.note: 35% limit does not apply to the rear window if the vehicle has 2 outside mirrors (one each side); otherwise 35%

tint.measuredHow: film + glass combined ('net of glass and material')
tint.dualMirrors: Required for rear side/rear window darker than 35%: 2 outside rear view mirrors, one on each side (§ 1916(2)(B))
tint.certificateOrSticker: Owner/operator of a vehicle with tinting material must acquire a light transmittance certificate (issued by persons authorized by the Chief of the State Police) and show it at inspection; failure to produce on request creates a presumption of non-compliance (§ 1916(3), (5)).

medicalExemption.text: Chief of the State Police may grant an exception when the health of the owner or a usual occupant is adversely affected by sunlight; certificate of exemption shown on request of an officer.

penalty.text: Traffic infraction, forfeiture of not less than $100 (no maximum stated)

quotes: A side window or rear window is composed of, covered by or treated with a material that allows a light transmittance of less than 35% net of glass and material
A window is composed of, covered by or treated with any material that is reflective

Sun-screening or window-tinting material above the AS-1 line in the top portion of the windshield or, if there is no AS-1 line in the top portion of the windshield, along a 5-inch strip at the top of the windshield.
do not apply to side windows behind the operator's seat or the rear window of a motor vehicle, as long as the vehicle is equipped with 2 outside rear view mirrors, one on each side
commits a traffic infraction that must be punished by a forfeiture of not less than $100.

helmet.conditions: Under 18 (operator or passenger), operators on a learner's permit or within one year of passing the driving test, and passengers of an operator required to wear one

handheldPhone.noviceOrAgeBan: Under 18, intermediate license and learner's permit holders may not use even hands-free mode (§ 2121(2))
handheldPhone.fineText: $50 first offense, $250 subsequent (handheld); texting: not less than $250 first, $500 repeat within 3 years plus suspension

studdedTires.season: prohibited May 1 - Oct 1 (allowed Oct 1 - May 1); Commissioner of Transportation may extend or permit

radarDetector.note: No state ban on radar detectors in private passenger vehicles found; commercial vehicles over 10,001 lb banned federally (49 CFR 392.71)

liftHeight.rule: Frame end height min 10 in.; max by GVWR: <=4,500 lb 24 in. front/26 in. rear; 4,501-7,500 lb 28/30; 7,501-10,000 lb 30/32; 10,001-11,500 lb 31/33; 11,501-13,000 lb 32/34 (measured from level surface to bottom of frame end)

openQuestions: Underglow: no specific Maine statute located (§ 2054 restricts emergency/auxiliary lights; not read in full).

§ 1916(1)(D) requires 2-way glass on front windshield, front door windows and windows at either end of the rear passenger seat - interplay with § 1916(2)(B) mirror exception reviewed: exception covers paragraphs C and D for windows behind the operator.
